/*selectMasterMpIvDeliveryDelayList*/ SELECT X.BUYER AS BUYER_CODE , (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=X.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME , X.AGENT AS AGENT_CODE , (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=X.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME , MAX(DO_CNT) AS DO_CNT , MAX(DS_CNT) AS DS_CNT , MAX(IV_CNT) AS IV_CNT FROM ( SELECT B.BUYER , B.AGENT , COUNT(A.PO_NO) AS DO_CNT , 0 AS DS_CNT , 0 AS IV_CNT FROM ICOMPODT A, ICOMPOHD B WHERE A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND B.PO_CREATE_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} AND B.PO_CREATE_DATE <= KEP.F_GET_M_WORKINGDAY(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),2) AND A.DO_QTY = 0 AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND B.STATUS != 'D' AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} GROUP BY B.BUYER, B.AGENT
UNION ALL
SELECT B.BUYER , B.AGENT , 0 AS DO_CNT , COUNT(A.PO_NO) AS DS_CNT , 0 AS IV_CNT FROM ICOMPODT A, ICOMPOHD B WHERE A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND B.PO_CREATE_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} AND A.DO_QTY > 0 AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND B.STATUS != 'D' AND A.COMPLETE_MARK ='N' AND A.DS_DATE <= KEP.F_GET_M_WORKINGDAY(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),2) AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} GROUP BY B.BUYER, B.AGENT
UNION ALL
SELECT B.BUYER , B.AGENT , 0 AS DO_CNT , 0 AS DS_CNT , COUNT(A.PO_NO) AS IV_CNT FROM ICOMPODT A, ICOMPOHD B WHERE A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND B.PO_CREATE_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND B.STATUS != 'D' AND A.ST_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AND KEP.F_GET_WORKINGDAY(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),3) AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} AND (DO_QTY=0 OR A.COMPLETE_MARK ='N') GROUP BY B.BUYER, B.AGENT ) X
WHERE X.AGENT = #{st_agent_code}
GROUP BY X.BUYER, X.AGENT ORDER BY AGENT_NAME
